orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Raghvendra Singh Chauhan,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
04.03.2021 
FA No. 119 of 2018 
Hon’ble Raghvendra Singh Chauhan, C.J.
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Mr. L.K. Tiwari, learned counsel for 
the appellant. 
Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned 
counsel for the respondent. 
Both the learned counsel are, ad 
idem, that the parties were married on 
13.10.1996 and separated in the year 
2005. After the gap of 16 years, the 
chances of reconciliation are absolutely 
nil, especially, considering the fact that, 
according to the learned counsel for the 
respondent, the respondent has re￾married during the pendency of the 
present appeal. Therefore, the only issue 
that needs to be decided by this Court is 
with regard to the permanent alimony 
which is payable by the respondent to the 
appellant-wife.  Therefore, this Court directs the 
respondent to submit an affidavit clearly 
stating the post that he is working 
against, as he is said to be a government 
employee, the gross monthly income and 
net monthly income being received by 
him, the bank statement of the accounts 
held by him, the Income Tax Returns, if 
any, for the last three years and the 
statement with regard to the moveable 
and immovable properties either owned 
by him personally or by his joint family. 
The said affidavit shall be submitted 
by the respondent on or before 
01.04.2021. 
List this case on 01.04.2021. 
A copy of the affidavit shall be 
furnished to the learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Raghvendra Singh Chauhan, C.J.)
 04.03.2021 04.03.2021 
NISHANT
